covers: The handlers and callbacks of the OKI MSM5205, a chip with no register file, numbered in the order the header declares them

entries.name: set_prescaler_selector
entries.description: Machine-configuration call that presets the rate selectors and the data width from one of eight constants.
entries.behaviour: Bit 0 sets S1, bit 1 sets S2 and bit 2 chooses 4-bit data when set, 3-bit when clear, so S96_3B is 0 and SEX_4B is 7. It only stores the three values, without updating the stream or restarting the VCK timer as playmode_w does. A chip never configured starts as S96_4B.

entries.name: vck_callback
entries.description: Output callback bound by the driver: it receives every level of the VCK pin, the cue to supply the next nibble with data_w.
entries.behaviour: In a master mode a timer toggles VCK every prescaler/2 clocks and calls this with the new level, so each sample has a rising and a falling edge. In slave mode (S1 and S2 both set) the timer is stopped and it is never called. The nibble is captured 6 clocks after the falling edge.

entries.name: vck_legacy_callback
entries.description: Second output callback: it is called with 1 once per sample, at the capture point after the falling edge of VCK.
entries.behaviour: Called only when bound. It runs just before the chip reads its latched nibble, so a data_w made inside it decides that sample. In master mode it fires 6 clocks after each falling edge, in slave mode 6 clocks after a vclk_w that fell.

entries.name: reset_w
entries.description: Reset pin: nonzero holds the decoder at rest, zero lets it play.
entries.behaviour: The value is only stored, and is checked at each capture point. While set, a capture forces the signal and the step index to 0 and ignores the latched nibble, which stays. The header asks to hold it for two VCK cycles; it is 0 after a device reset.

entries.name: data_w
entries.description: Supplies the next ADPCM nibble; it is latched and decoded at the next capture point.
entries.behaviour: In 4-bit mode bits 0 to 3 are latched; in 3-bit mode bits 0 to 2 are latched shifted up one place, so input bit 2 becomes the sign. The chip decodes the last value written before the capture and imposes no nibble order. Bit 3 of the latched nibble is the sign, bits 0 to 2 the magnitude.

entries.name: vclk_w
entries.description: VCK input for slave mode: the driver supplies the clock edges itself.
entries.behaviour: Valid only in slave mode (S1 and S2 both set); in any other mode it logs an error and changes nothing. On a 1 to 0 change it schedules the capture 6 clocks later, then stores the level. The header asks to call it after data_w and reset_w when they change at the same time.

entries.name: playmode_w
entries.description: Sets the rate selectors S1 and S2 and the data width from one byte.
entries.behaviour: Bit 0 is S1, bit 1 is S2, bit 2 chooses 4-bit data when set, else 3-bit; other bits are ignored. A change of S1 or S2 updates the stream and restarts the VCK timer: prescaler 96 with both clear, 48 with S1 only, 64 with S2 only, slave mode with both. Sample rate is clock over prescaler.

entries.name: s1_w
entries.behaviour: A nonzero state sets S1 and zero clears it; a change updates the stream and restarts the VCK timer for the new prescaler, an unchanged value does nothing. The data width is untouched. The prescaler table is under playmode_w.

entries.name: s2_w
entries.behaviour: A nonzero state sets S2 and zero clears it; a change updates the stream and restarts the VCK timer for the new prescaler, an unchanged value does nothing. The data width is untouched. The prescaler table is under playmode_w.
